issue_request: FHIR-9592 asked for a new attribute for device software manufacturer, distinct from the physical device manufacturer. The issue is Published and resolved Not Persuasive with Modification; the material decision was to avoid a new attribute and clarify component/boundaries modeling instead.
initial_application: No current source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-9592 was found. The original resolution referred to DeviceComponent.productSpecification, but DeviceComponent is now commented out or marked dropped in source/fhir.ini. Later Device updates/refactors introduced the current Device scope/boundaries text and Device/DeviceDefinition deviceVersion.component structures.
additional_context: Device and DeviceDefinition are active/approved in source/fhir.ini. Current Device narrative says devices may include software and that a Device may represent a component of an encapsulating device; Device and DeviceDefinition each have manufacturer plus deviceVersion component/value structures. Jira searches found only FHIR-9592 for the targeted software manufacturer/productSpecification queries, and Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Adding a new attribute would contradict the final resolution, and adding more narrative would duplicate active Device scope, boundaries, and version/component guidance. The obsolete DeviceComponent source is outside current build scope.
